svg.title: Lambertian emitter propagation through a finite aperture
svg.desc: In an unfolded reflection view, points across a finite Lambertian emitter send straight rays at many angles through an aperture, over the unfolded distance L, to a geometry-dependent object-plane irradiance distribution with penumbra. The emitter outline is not a fixed beam cross-section. A lower inset draws the irradiance-integral geometry: a source element dA s around s, the object point P, their separation r, and the obliquity angles theta s and theta P to the plane normals.
svg.text: A Lambertian emitter is not a same-size collimated beam
unfolded reflection view: source position + angular distribution + aperture visibility determine Object-plane irradiance

svg.text: A plane fold can be “unfolded” into this straight path.
It redirects radiance but does not form a 1:1 real image of the LED.
